top_violation_types.title: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §747.3203)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The breezeway utilized by children to go outside had a strong cigarette odor.

top_violation_types.title: Smoke-Detection System (26 TAC §747.5111)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The smoke detector was not working and there was not a smoke detector in the front room.

top_violation_types.title: First Aid Kit Incomplete -Thermometer, preferably non-glass (26 TAC §747.3803(a)(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The first aid kit lacked a thermometer.

top_violation_types.title: Written Activity Plan - Develop and Follow (26 TAC §747.2102(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a written activity plan.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Instructions for Contacting Licensing Office/Online and TX Abuse & Neglect Hotline (26 TAC §747.501(11))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have the required emergency preparedness plan.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Nine Inches if Equipment Greater Than 5 Ft. (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An outdoor structure that consisted of a slide and climbing that measured over 5 feet, did not have the required 9 inches of loose-fill. There was not sufficient enough loose-fill around the structure to rake in place at the time of the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions (26 TAC §746.4601(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A one year old child was allowed to play on playground equipment that is designed for children ages five through twelve, resulting in an injury that required medical attention.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employee records evaluated was unavailable for review.     One out of four employee records evaluated was incomplete.
